name: network-hogs
title: Network Hogs
description: Find which apps are using your network, see live download and upload rates, and quit bandwidth hogs.
author: ray.dhruv

commands.name: network-hogs
commands.title: Network Hogs
commands.description: See live per-app network rates, traffic charts, and session usage

commands.name: top-network-app
commands.title: Top Network App
commands.description: Show the busiest network app in the menu bar

tools.name: get-network-usage
tools.title: Get Network Usage
tools.description: Read current per-app download and upload rates from a fresh one-second observation. Returns byte rates and totals for that observation only. Does not quit apps or measure internet speed.

preferences.name: animateCharts
preferences.title: Chart Animation
preferences.label: Animate new traffic samples
preferences.description: Slide the chart into place over 200 ms when a sample arrives. Disable for instant updates.

preferences.name: units
preferences.title: Rate Units
preferences.description: Display rates in bytes per second or bits per second. Session usage always uses bytes.

preferences.name: menuBarThreshold
preferences.title: Menu Bar Threshold (KB/s)
preferences.description: Show the busiest app's name above this combined rate, in KB/s. Set to 0 to show any traffic.

preferences.name: hideSystemDaemons
preferences.title: System Daemons
preferences.label: Hide system daemons and shared services
preferences.description: Hide macOS background services and processes owned by other users.

preferences.name: showUpload
preferences.title: Menu Bar Upload
preferences.label: Include the upload rate in the menu bar title
preferences.description: Show upload alongside the busiest app's combined rate.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
